headline: Big green day rides IREN's bounce and AMD's grind
summary: The book posted a strong +2.75% day, but the gain is a bounce inside existing drawdowns, not a turn - AMD is the one clean winner, while IREN, AVGO, and MSFT are still deep in the red despite today's strength.
watch: WBX at $5.58 vs the $4.60 exit trigger - 17% cushion but a fast microcap, watch for a close through that level to exit the stub entirely
AAPL at $312.60 sits between both live triggers - $300 stop-loss on a new buy and $317 confirmed close to execute the queued $250 add - no action until it picks a side
AVGO's RSI at 44.8 is a hair from re-triggering its own watchpoint; confirm broader strength before adding to a position still down -10.8%
NEE watchpoint (BUY) fired - decide on opening the starter, size it to ≤1.5% book risk with a stop set before entry, not after
PANW still above RSI 70 and CRWD still above RSI 60 - both entries remain forbidden until pullbacks confirm
IREN's RSI 39 recovery needs volume confirmation tomorrow before treating today's pop as anything more than an oversold bounce - no averaging down into the -27.3% hole regardless
recap: IREN +14.7% today but still -27.3% P/L - a sharp bounce inside a deep hole, RSI 39 climbing out of oversold, not confirmation of a trend change
AMD +6.5% today, now +9.7% P/L - the only position actually working
AVGO +3.8% today but still -10.8% P/L; its RSI≥45 watchpoint fired repeatedly and RSI now sits at 44.8, right on that line
MSFT -0.8%, -11.5% P/L - no bounce participation, the weakest holding today
NEE watchpoint (BUY) fired even though NEE itself was -0.9% today with neutral RSI 50
Runner-ignition AVOID signals hit on SEER, PEW, YDES, WRAP - none held, correctly filtered as low-float chases
